addExisting.description: Skills your workspace already has that this AI Employee does not.
addExisting.emptyDescription: This AI Employee already has every skill your workspace shares. Create a new one to give it more.

global.noAgentsDescription: Create an AI Employee first. Skills live with your AI Employees, and this page manages them across all of them.

manage.keepOneAgent: Keep at least one AI Employee, or use Delete to remove the skill everywhere.

manage.removeConfirmDescription: Saving will remove this skill from {{names}}. This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteConfirmDescription_one: This removes the skill from {{count}} AI Employee ({{names}}). This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteConfirmDescription_other: This removes the skill from {{count}} AI Employees ({{names}}). This cannot be undone.
manage.deleteSharedDescription: This removes the skill from the workspace for every AI Employee. AI Employees with a modified copy keep their own version.

chatPick.title: Who should build it with you?
chatPick.description: The chat runs with this AI Employee, who also gets the skill. It lands in your workspace, so you can add it to other AI Employees whenever you want.

global.overrideReverted: {{name}} is back on the workspace version

scopedOverride.title: This AI Employee has its own version
scopedOverride.description: You are editing the version this AI Employee runs. The workspace version stays as it is.
scopedOverride.disableConfirmTitle: Delete this AI Employee's own version?
scopedOverride.disableConfirmBody: This AI Employee stops using the skill, and the version it has of its own is deleted with everything unsaved here. The workspace version and every other AI Employee stay as they are. This cannot be undone.
scopedOverride.revertConfirmTitle: Go back to the workspace version?
scopedOverride.revertConfirmBody: This AI Employee follows the workspace version from now on, and the version it has of its own is deleted with everything unsaved here. This cannot be undone.

scopedWorkspace.title: This is the workspace version
scopedWorkspace.description: Changes apply to every AI Employee that uses this skill.

global.promoted: Skill is now shared across your workspace
